name: Jie Liu
evidence: No org, no profile, and "Jie Liu" is one of the most common Chinese names in CS, with hundreds of distinct researchers. The only anchor is the paper "Evaluation and Optimization of Large Language Models for Cross-Cultural Sentiment Analysis and Text Generation"; GitHub code search for that exact title returned just 2 hits, both entries in the benchmark index zjsxply/llm-capabilities-landscape (docs/en|zh/01-core-capabilities/14-writing/03-bench.md), which give only the DOI 10.1109/aieta69357.2026.11508902 (IEEE AIETA 2026) and no author list or contact. With no way to distinguish this Jie Liu from namesakes, any address would be unsafe; namesake rule applied. No WebSearch spent.
